items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He was playing in Charlie's Chicken Shack in Toledo, Ohio, and he used to come around to McKinney's band to listen and Don would usually have him sit in.

ctx.x: : (Unintelligible.) He could really do that, too, can't he?

Oh, he could do anything. Anything. I first heard him in Toledo, Ohio, when I was with McKinney's band and nobody knew about him. He was playing in Charlie's Chicken Shack in Toledo, Ohio, and he used to come around to McKinney's band to listen and Don would usually have him sit in.
